events.content:
Built **Bookend**, a small reading tracker with no accounts or database. The home page shows currently reading and finished books. You can add a title, author, and notes; mark a book finished; and open or copy a direct link to its book page.

Books are saved in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json) and remain available after a restart. To run the app:

```sh
npm start
```

Then open `http://localhost:3000`. Shareable book links work when the server is reachable by the recipient. Setup details are in the [README](/workspace/README.md).

I verified adding a book, opening its direct URL, marking it finished, and reading it back after a server restart. I also checked that Unicode notes are saved correctly.

Books are saved in [data/books.json](/workspace/data/books.json) and remain available after a restart. To run the app:

```sh
npm start
```

Then open `http://localhost:3000`. Shareable book links work when the server is reachable by the recipient. Setup details are in the [README](/workspace/README.md).

I verified adding a book, opening its direct URL, marking it finished, and reading it back after a server restart. I also checked that Unicode notes are saved correctly.
